cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. First day in accounts, and I've reconciled this invoice. I put it in the right drawer. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's filing. Reconciliation means matching it to our records.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Filed, then. I'll reconcile it against this quote.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an estimate. You need the purchase order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Estimate filed; purchase order requested. I'm getting fluent in accounts already.

mechanism: A takes charge of an accounts task and recruits a colleague to guide each newly corrected official term.
confusable: Unlike knowing the jargon but making a filing error, A repeatedly misuses and then adopts the actual definitions to belong.
comparison: Invoice matching and purchase orders differ from a club vote and recording minutes.
seedUse: D186-a invoice and quote corrections; S02-a keeps the task by giving B the guiding role.
